body:
Upstream issue: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/31598
Mirror issue: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/issues/3442

## What changed

Reproduced the reported `sent_offset` retreat through the actual `DetokenizerManager._decode_batch_token_id_output` path using the exact CJK/incomplete-UTF8 prefix progression. The recovery branch now preserves the greatest already-emitted offset during an incomplete-text recovery run, without clamping clean commits, completion, or non-streaming transitions.

Added manager-level regression coverage for repeated recovery, independent client chunk concatenation, mixed batched requests, clean text, finish-after-recovery, and direct non-streaming materialization. Raw before/after output and the inspected issue/PR snapshots are retained under `reports/j-417759ff54e4/raw/`; the structured result is in `reports/j-417759ff54e4/result.json`.

## Reproduction and validation

Before the source fix:

```bash
/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-417759ff54e4/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/managers/test_detokenizer_stream_offset.py
```

Result: 3 failed, 1 passed. Recovery-sensitive paths emitted `A 世世ab` (or the equivalent duplicated completion chunk); direct non-streaming passed.

After the source fix, the same command reports 4 passed. Also validated:

```bash
/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-417759ff54e4/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/managers/test_trim_matched_stop.py
/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-417759ff54e4/venv/bin/python -m pre_commit run --files python/sglang/srt/managers/detokenizer_manager.py test/registered/unit/managers/test_detokenizer_stream_offset.py
```

Result: 8 adjacent tests passed; all selected hooks passed.

## Limitations

The regression uses the real manager implementation with a deterministic table tokenizer to force the reported decoded prefixes. No model-weight HTTP serving run or GPU execution was performed because the defect is CPU-side Python offset bookkeeping; this does not qualify every tokenizer/model architecture, distributed serving, or semantic model output. No native code changed.
